body:
Current-target assessment completed without source integration. Actual master is `b46e9e8`; PR38 remains `9cada311`, with API/merge base `7688118`. Incoming release/version paths are disjoint from translation changes and do not change the dependency graph. The description now distinguishes these identities, records merged PR46 and excludes open PR49's native pod fix.

[Impact and exact historical preservation](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/b51b6884ee67afab2fd305fdad90720f517a4094/target-b46-impact/README.md) and [final publication bindings](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/161b2c50e427a9052bd5939f03ae25ccd87df2d7/target-b46-publication/record.json) support same-QA reassessment. The 12 original captures remain applicable to translation behavior; build/version identities are not relabeled. No tests, exports or captures were newly executed against b46 or a combined build.

Draft/readiness/Project state is unchanged. Implementation is clean and idle; the coordinator owns the same-QA handoff and any readiness decision.
